title: Vapouriz 50/50 Ice Mint 10ml
description: Ice Mint from the Vapouriz 50/50 collection is a seriously refreshing vape that should please any menthol fan. The crisp, delicately sweet taste of mint meets your tastebuds on the inhale, falling away to an icy, invigorating menthol breeze on the exhale. Vapouriz 50/50 takes some of the classic flavours from Vapouriz Premium’s bestselling collection of e-liquids, adds several new equally unique flavours, and bottles them in a 50% Vegetable Glycerine / 50% Propylene Glycol ratio. This ideal balance provides a full-flavoured vape, with a discreet amount of vapour and a silky-smooth, comfortable throat hit. When it comes to vaping, 50/50 e-liquids really do offer the best of all worlds. All e-liquids contain Propylene Glycol (PG) and Vegetable Glycerine (VG) in various ratios. PG carries flavour the best and provides a tactile ‘throat hit’ that vapers are familiar with from smoking, while VG is the ingredient that aids vapour production. But since 50/50 e-liquids carry equal quantities of both, every vape you take is a flavoursome experience that produces a satisfying, yet not excessive, amount of vapour, while being comfortable on the throat. 50/50 e-liquids are among the most versatile e-liquids available, and can be used in most vape kits. However, 50/50 e-liquids perform best in low-resistance devices such as Starter Vape Kits , Pen Vape Kits and Pod Vape Kits .
